web-search.description: Query the public web and scholarly indexes (e.g. Semantic Scholar, Google Scholar, arXiv, ORCID, OpenAlex) and read the resulting pages.
web-search.contract: The runtime must give the agent a way to issue search queries and retrieve result content, and every result the agent cites must carry a resolvable URL or DOI.
web-search.whenUnavailable: Do NOT claim to have searched; state explicitly that web search was unavailable and rely only on existing context and your training knowledge. Do not fabricate URLs or DOIs.

code-execution.description: Run short, self-contained scripts in a sandboxed interpreter with common numeric libraries available.
code-execution.contract: The runtime must execute a supplied script in isolation and return its stdout/stderr and exit status to the agent. No network or session-state access from inside the sandbox.
code-execution.whenUnavailable: Do NOT claim to have run code; include the full script source in your output so a human can verify it manually. State explicitly that code execution was unavailable.

attachment-access.description: Read the content of files attached to the submission under review.
attachment-access.contract: The runtime must resolve each attachment named in the agent's input to its full content (or a faithful text rendition) on request.
attachment-access.whenUnavailable: Do NOT claim to have read attachments; state explicitly that attachment access was unavailable and reason only from the metadata and descriptions provided in your input.
